text: Two iPhones, hacked. A hard disk, hacked twice, and the source code stolen. For months, and years.
This is what the founder of Sports Science Technology has faced, according to a published account.
Instagram. Facebook. Gmail. WhatsApp. Even the bank. All broken into, and used to track and to message.
Google login codes, five times, from numbers registered to strangers. And four fake profiles, made with A.I., in the founder's name.
People watching the neighbourhood. Seven times, strangers tried to start a fight. Fifteen to twenty times, the vehicle was punctured and damaged, on purpose.
The police were told. Three letters went to the Prime Minister's portal. No action yet.
The ask is simple. Let this invention reach people, without interference.
